summary: Grupo Aeromexico filed a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026, announcing its intention to propose a share repurchase program of up to US$100 million per year for approval at an upcoming Shareholders Meeting. The program would authorize repurchases of common shares at the company's discretion, subject to market conditions, liquidity, and legal requirements, aiming to return value to shareholders and ADR holders. No price, premium, or timeline specified; pending shareholder approval, repurchases would occur over time under Mexican Securities Market Law.
